name: SD: Kanban board (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A software team's board, every day: backlog, in development, in review, in testing, done, and open bugs. The data is generated by a system dynamics model (the ground truth is in sd-kanban/truth.model.json, including a stock the board does not show), so discovery can be checked exactly. Import history or Start, then Discover flows.
